prompt: Extract the audio from my video input.mp4 and save it as a high-quality AAC file without re-encoding if possible, otherwise use standard AAC encoding.
expected: Use ffmpeg with -vn (no video) and appropriate audio codec/copy settings.

prompt: I need to trim the first 30 seconds of a very large movie file accurately, but do it fast. Then scale the output to 720p.
expected: Use fast input seek plus duration/trim, then apply scale filter with re-encode.
actual: ffmpeg -ss 00:00:00 -i input.mkv -t 30 -vf scale=-1:720 -c:v libx264 -c:a copy output.mp4
